components.name: Brand Mark
components.description: The sharp split-color DP mark used in the top bar.
components.css: .ds-brand-mark { border: 1px solid var(--ink, #20231f); color: var(--ink, #20231f); display: grid; font: 700 10px/1 var(--font-geist-mono, monospace); grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; height: 38px; letter-spacing: -0.06em; width: 38px; } .ds-brand-mark span { align-items: center; display: flex; justify-content: center; } .ds-brand-mark span:first-child { background: var(--ink, #20231f); color: var(--paper, #fbf8f0); }

components.name: Reader Navigation
components.description: Dark file navigation with fixed arrow controls and a truncating path.
components.css: .ds-reader-nav { align-items: stretch; background: var(--ink, #20231f); border-radius: 15px 15px 0 0; color: #f8f4ea; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 60px minmax(0, 1fr) 60px; height: 60px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-nav-button, .ds-current-file { background: transparent; border: 0; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-button { font: 400 22px/1 var(--font-geist-mono, monospace); transition: background 160ms ease, color 160ms ease; } .ds-nav-button:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 9%); color: #fff; } .ds-nav-button:focus-visible, .ds-current-file:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #426b7c); outline-offset: -3px; } .ds-current-file { align-items: center; display: flex; gap: 13px; min-width: 0; padding: 0 20px; text-align: left; } .ds-current-file small { color: #bcbcb3; font: 600 10px/1 var(--font-geist-mono, monospace); } .ds-current-file span { color: #e6e2d9; font: 520 12px/1.2 var(--font-geist-mono, monospace); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Text Action
components.description: A low-weight action for expanding diffs and opening source links.
components.css: .ds-text-action { background: transparent; border: 0; color: var(--ink, #20231f); cursor: pointer; font: 650 10px/1.2 var(--font-geist-sans, Arial, sans-serif); padding: 7px 0; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #aaa99f; text-underline-offset: 4px; } .ds-text-action:hover { text-decoration-color: var(--ink, #20231f); } .ds-text-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #426b7c); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-text-action:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.css: .ds-status-chip { border: 1px solid #525751; border-radius: 99px; color: #c7cbc4; display: inline-flex; font: 600 10px/1 var(--font-geist-mono, monospace); letter-spacing: 0.04em; padding: 6px 9px; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-status-chip--added { border-color: rgb(113 183 140 / 45%); color: #a8d4b7; }

components.name: File Search
components.description: The mono search field used in the changed-file picker.
components.css: .ds-file-search { align-items: center; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d8d1c4); border-top: 1px solid var(--line, #d8d1c4); color: var(--ink, #20231f); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 26px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; padding: 0 3px; } .ds-file-search > span { color: var(--muted, #73766d); font-size: 22px; } .ds-file-search input { background: transparent; border: 0; color: inherit; font: 500 13px/1 var(--font-geist-mono, monospace); height: 52px; min-width: 0; outline: 0; } .ds-file-search input::placeholder { color: #a6a49b; } .ds-file-search small { color: var(--muted, #73766d); font: 500 9px/1 var(--font-geist-mono, monospace); } .ds-file-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--blue, #426b7c); }

components.name: Changed File Row
components.description: A searchable file-picker row with status and line totals.
components.css: .ds-file-row { align-items: center; background: transparent; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; color: var(--ink, #20231f); cursor: pointer; display: grid; gap: 11px; grid-template-columns: 30px 8px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; min-height: 43px; padding: 0 14px; text-align: left; width: 100%; } .ds-file-row:hover { background: #ece7dc; } .ds-file-row:focus-visible { background: #ece7dc; box-shadow: inset 2px 0 var(--ink, #20231f); outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #426b7c); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-file-index { color: var(--quiet, #aaa99f); font: 500 9px/1 var(--font-geist-mono, monospace); } .ds-status-pin { background: #71b78c; border-radius: 999px; height: 7px; width: 7px; } .ds-file-path { font: 520 11px/1.2 var(--font-geist-mono, monospace); overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-change-count { display: flex; font: 600 9px/1 var(--font-geist-mono, monospace); gap: 9px; } .ds-change-count i { color: var(--green, #2f6c4d); font-style: normal; } .ds-change-count b { color: var(--red, #a14f45); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Diff Change Rows
components.description: The signature old-line, new-line, marker, and code grid for additions and deletions.
components.html:
1212+const clear = summarize(diff);
13−const summary = rawText;
components.css: .ds-diff { background: var(--paper, #fbf8f0); color: var(--ink, #20231f); font: 450 11.5px/1.6 var(--font-geist-mono, monospace); overflow: auto; } .ds-diff-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 42px 42px 26px minmax(320px, 1fr); min-height: 21px; } .ds-diff-row > span { color: #aaa89f; font-size: 10px; padding-right: 10px; text-align: right; } .ds-diff-row > b { font-weight: 650; text-align: center; } .ds-diff-row > code { padding: 1px 18px 0 6px; white-space: pre; } .ds-diff-row--add { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--green-soft, #dce9dc), #e7f0e4 82%, transparent); } .ds-diff-row--add b, .ds-diff-row--add code { color: var(--green, #2f6c4d); } .ds-diff-row--delete { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--red-soft, #f1ddda), #f5e5e1 82%, transparent); } .ds-diff-row--delete b, .ds-diff-row--delete code { color: var(--red, #a14f45); } .ds-diff-row:hover { filter: brightness(0.985); }

components.name: Risk Callout
components.description: The only rounded note inside the summary pane, reserved for risks.
components.html:
CHECK CLOSELY

  • The branch may change before the review finishes.
components.css: .ds-risk { background: #eee5d8; border: 1px solid #d6c9b7; border-radius: 8px; color: #454942; font-family: var(--font-geist-sans, Arial, sans-serif); padding: 17px 18px 14px; } .ds-risk > p { color: #805a22; font: 650 9px/1.2 var(--font-geist-mono, monospace); letter-spacing: 0.12em; margin: 0; } .ds-risk ul { list-style: none; margin: 11px 0 0; padding: 0; } .ds-risk li { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.55; padding: 5px 0 5px 18px; position: relative; } .ds-risk li::before { background: var(--amber, #9c7027); content: ''; height: 1px; left: 0; position: absolute; top: 14px; width: 8px; }

narrative.overview:
Diff Presenter uses a measured, editorial system built for close reading. Warm paper surfaces, dark ink, compact mono labels, and a strong split between source evidence and agent notes make the interface feel ordered without making it stark.

The system stays mostly flat. Borders, tone shifts, and spacing separate regions; shadows mark only the main reader and the file picker. The diff remains the main work area, while the narrower note pane adds context in a quieter reading rhythm.
keyCharacteristics: Sans type for explanation and mono type for evidence
Flat structure led by borders and tonal layers
Semantic color for additions, deletions, review markers, and risks
Brief directional motion with a reduced-motion path

rules.name: The Meaningful Color Rule
rules.body: Use green, red, blue, and amber to convey change or review state; do not use them as decoration.

rules.name: The Mono Rule
rules.body: Use Geist Mono for code, paths, counts, shortcuts, metadata, and short labels; keep full explanations in Geist.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Use borders and tonal layers inside the reader; reserve ambient shadows for the full sheet and modal overlays.

dos: Do keep the warm paper and Carbon Ink base on review surfaces.
Do reserve semantic colors for additions, deletions, review structure, and risks.
Do use Geist Mono for code and compact evidence, and Geist for explanation.
Do use borders and tonal layers before adding a shadow.
Do keep the diff wider than the note pane on large screens.
Do honor both responsive breakpoints and `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: Don't use semantic green, red, blue, or amber as general decoration.
Don't turn every inner region into a rounded card.
Don't add ambient shadows to rows, notes, or routine controls.
Don't replace the code grid with a proportional font.
Don't let secondary metadata crowd navigation on small screens.
